outcome: composite neonatal adverse outcomes (Apgar score < 5 at 5 minutes, assisted ventilation > 6 hours, seizure, neonatal or infant mortality)
composite maternal adverse outcomes (maternal transfusion, ruptured uterus, unplanned hysterectomy, admission to intensive care unit, unplanned procedure)
cohort: The study included singleton, nonanomalous large for gestational age (LGA) live births delivered between 24 and 41 weeks gestation with known maternal diabetes status, extracted from the U.S. Vital Statistics dataset.
finding: In pregnancies with LGA newborns, both composite neonatal and maternal morbidities were significantly higher among individuals with diabetes compared with those without diabetes.
